# Pack: monit-live

CERN MONIT monitoring snapshots (SAM, HTCondor, Rucio) and the live MONIT query tools.

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Kind | `context` |
| Version | `0.1.0` |
| Needs a credential to publish | yes |
| Okg modules it needs | `document_starter`, `person`, `extraction`, `dataset` |
| Packs it needs | [`cms-catalogs`](../packs/cms-catalogs.md) |

## In which bundles

- Default in: none
- Optional in: [`cms-comp-ops`](../bundles/cms-comp-ops.md)

Add it to an instance with `archi add monit-live`.

## Sources

- `monit-live.monit_condor`
- `monit-live.monit_rucio_datasets`

## Questions

This pack asks no questions.

## Credentials

The pack reads these environment variables. Only the names are listed. Set them in the environment of the shell that runs ingestion (okg and the downloaders): archi does not pass values from the instance's `.env` to ingestion.

- `MONIT_GRAFANA_TOKEN`
